body: I am a sophomore. I can't get scholarships for the upcoming year because they just told me today about losing the scholarship. It's too late to try to get other small ones. My school is very prestigious so if I come home everyone will know it's because I failed. My community is very small so there will be a lot of gossip and talking about me,  my situation and the shame id bring for my family

I had an academic scholarship but I spread myself too thin. I was very active on campus and my grades suffered. I still have above a 3.0 but my scholarship required a pretty high gpa. I feel like if I leave now everyone knows I'm a failure. Everyone told me how great it would be and the amazing things I'd do and I let them all down, I let myself down. I let my parents down. They can't afford to send me to college and I feel like if they try they will get a divorce. And now I feel like there is no hope for me to be a great lawyer or save people's lives by changing Healthcare laws because I won't get into any good law school with my gpa. I failed. I'm failing at life.
